# Aixuno PDF — PDF Tools

> Free browser-based PDF toolkit: merge, split, compress, rotate, unlock, sign and convert PDF files. Documents are processed locally in the browser and are never uploaded to an Aixuno server.

## Site

- Name: Aixuno PDF
- Homepage: https://pdf.aixuno.com/
- Purpose: edit and convert PDF files without uploading them
- All tools: https://pdf.aixuno.com/tools

## Organise pages

- Merge PDF: https://pdf.aixuno.com/merge-pdf
- Split PDF: https://pdf.aixuno.com/split-pdf
- Delete pages: https://pdf.aixuno.com/delete-pages
- Extract pages: https://pdf.aixuno.com/extract-pages
- Reorder pages: https://pdf.aixuno.com/reorder-pages
- Rotate PDF: https://pdf.aixuno.com/rotate-pdf
- Crop PDF: https://pdf.aixuno.com/crop-pdf
- Insert pages: https://pdf.aixuno.com/insert-pages
- Create blank PDF: https://pdf.aixuno.com/create-blank-pdf
- Page numbers: https://pdf.aixuno.com/page-number

## Edit and secure

- Compress PDF: https://pdf.aixuno.com/compress-pdf
- Watermark PDF: https://pdf.aixuno.com/watermark-pdf

## Convert

- PDF to JPG: https://pdf.aixuno.com/pdf-to-jpg
- PDF to PNG: https://pdf.aixuno.com/pdf-to-png
- JPG to PDF: https://pdf.aixuno.com/jpg-to-pdf
- PNG to PDF: https://pdf.aixuno.com/png-to-pdf
- Image to PDF: https://pdf.aixuno.com/image-to-pdf

## Key facts

- Processing runs on the user's device; documents never leave the browser.
- No account, no upload limit, no watermark on output.
- Powered by PDF.js and WebAssembly workers loaded on demand.
